## Utilities

Utility functions to supplement the package. Includes a simple basis expansion system, a spatio-temporal data type, tools for testing jit-functions and so on.

| [utils.random_basis](utils.random_basis.qmd#jaxidem.utils.random_basis) | Randomly distributes knots (centroids) and scales for basis functions. |
| [utils.place_cosine_basis](utils.place_cosine_basis.qmd#jaxidem.utils.place_cosine_basis) | Creates cosine (fourier) basis functions at N frequencies at each dimension. |
